welcome.title: Welcome to Wren
welcome.description: Wren turns your voice into text anywhere you can type. Press a shortcut, speak, and the transcription lands wherever your cursor is. Let's set up the essentials — it only takes a minute.
engine.title: Where should transcription happen?
engine.description: This is the most important choice: it decides whether your voice ever leaves this computer.
engine.local.title: On this computer (local)
engine.local.description: Private by default — audio never leaves your machine. Runs a speech model on your own hardware; needs a one-time download and depends on your computer's power.
engine.remote.title: A remote service (e.g. Groq)
engine.remote.description: Faster and more accurate on modest hardware, but your audio is sent to that service's servers. Requires a free account and an API key.
engine.technicalNote: Both paths implement the same Transcriber contract, so you can switch providers later in Settings → Provider without losing anything else you configure here.
local.title: Choose a local model
local.description: Larger models transcribe more accurately but need more computer power and disk space.
local.hardwareNote.ok: Your computer looks capable of running this comfortably.
local.hardwareNote.limited: Your computer has only {{cores}} CPU core(s). Local transcription will still work, but long dictations may feel slow — if that happens, try a smaller model or switch to a remote provider later in Settings.
remote.title: Connect a remote provider
remote.description: We've pre-filled Groq (fast, free-tier available). You can change this later in Settings → Provider.
remote.step1: Create a free account at console.groq.com
remote.step2: Open "API Keys" and click "Create API Key"
remote.step3: Copy the key and paste it below
remote.apiKey.label: API key
remote.apiKey.hint: Stored only on this computer, never shared except with the provider you chose.
shortcut.title: Set your dictation shortcut
shortcut.description: Press this combination anywhere to start dictating; press it again (or release, in push-to-talk) to stop. The text is delivered wherever your cursor is — no need to switch back to Wren.
test.title: Try it out
test.description: Click the field below, then use your shortcut and say this phrase out loud:
test.placeholder: Your dictated text will appear here…
test.success: It worked! Wren is ready to use.
test.phrases: Testing Wren for the first time today.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
This is my new voice dictation setup.
Coffee first, then I'll answer these emails.

done.title: All set
done.description: You can change any of this later in Settings. Happy dictating!
